restated_task: Replace the prerelease identifier comparison in Version._nat_cmp so that ASCII-only digit identifiers of arbitrary length are compared by their decimal value without calling int() (strip leading zeros, then compare length, then lexicographically), while preserving legacy behavior for non-ASCII digit identifiers (compare via int(), raising ValueError eagerly on failure) and for non-numeric identifiers (plain string comparison). Core version comparison (major, minor, patch) must still decide before prerelease is examined. All other Version behavior (parsing, constructor storage, build metadata handling, release ordering) remains unchanged.

interface_contract.name: semver.version.Version._nat_cmp
interface_contract.signature: _nat_cmp(cls: Type[Version], a: Optional[str], b: Optional[str]) -> int
interface_contract.behavior: Compare two prerelease strings (dot-separated identifiers) according to SemVer ordering with the following rules: (1) Split each string by '.'; empty or None becomes a single empty identifier. (2) For each identifier pair: classify as ASCII-numeric (all chars in '0123456789' and non-empty), non-ASCII-numeric (str.isdigit() true but not all ASCII), or non-numeric (str.isdigit() false). (3) If both numeric (either kind): compute values — ASCII-numeric by stripping leading zeros (all-zero becomes '0'), then length then lexicographic; non-ASCII-numeric by int() (may raise ValueError). Compare values numerically. (4) If one numeric and other non-numeric: numeric is lower (returns -1 if a is numeric). (5) If both non-numeric: compare as plain strings (lexicographic). (6) First non-zero result decides; if all compared identifiers equal, longer identifier list is higher. Empty identifier compares as non-numeric string.
error_cases: ValueError: raised eagerly when a non-ASCII-numeric identifier (str.isdigit() true but not all ASCII) fails int() conversion, but only when core versions are equal (i.e., _nat_cmp is invoked).

interface_contract.name: semver.version.Version.compare
interface_contract.behavior: Compare self with other version. Convert other to Version via parse (str), constructor (dict/tuple/list), or direct instance. First compare core version tuple (major, minor, patch); if different, return that result. If core equal, compare prerelease via _nat_cmp. If _nat_cmp returns 0, versions equal. If one has no prerelease (None or empty string) and other does, the one without prerelease is higher (release > prerelease). Build metadata is ignored. Returns negative if self < other, zero if equal, positive if self > other.
error_cases: TypeError: if other is not str, bytes, dict, tuple, list, or Version instance.
ValueError: propagated from Version.parse (invalid version string) or from _nat_cmp (non-ASCII-numeric identifier failing int() conversion when core versions equal).

acceptance_criteria: Version.parse('0.0.0-' + '1'*5000).compare('0.0.0-2') returns 1 and Version.parse('0.0.0-2').compare('0.0.0-' + '1'*5000) returns -1 (no ValueError).

Ordering of long numeric prereleases via Version.parse: '9'*4999 < '1'+'0'*4999; '1'+'0'*4998+'1' < '1'+'0'*4998+'2'; '1'*5000 < 'alpha'; 'alpha.'+'1'*5000 < 'alpha.'+'1'*5000+'.1'. For each pair low.compare(high) == -1, high.compare(low) == 1, and sorted([high, low]) == [low, high].
Build metadata ignored: Version.parse('0.0.0-' + '1'*5000) == Version.parse('0.0.0-' + '1'*5000).replace(build='other') and Version.parse('0.0.0-' + '1'*5000) < Version(0,0,0).

Constructor prerelease legacy comparison (Version(0,0,0, prerelease=left).compare(Version(0,0,0, prerelease=right))): ('0001','1')->0; ('000','0')->0; ('02','10')->-1; ('01.2','1.2')->0; ('2a','10a')->1; ('01a','1a')->-1; ('-1','0')->1; ('',None)->0; ('\u0661\u0662','12')->0; ('\uff11\uff12','13')->-1; ('1\u0662','12')->0; ('\u0660\u0660\u0661','1')->0. Reverse comparisons give negated results. Both .prerelease attributes stored as given.
Version.parse('0.0.0-' + p) raises ValueError for p in ('01', '01.2', '\u0661\u0662', '\uff11\uff12').
Version(0,0,0, prerelease=left).compare(Version(0,0,0, prerelease=right)) raises ValueError for (left,right) in (('\u00b2','2'), ('a.\u00b2','b.0'), ('a.0','b.\u00b2')).
Version(0,0,0, prerelease='\u00b2') < Version(1,0,0, prerelease='\u00b2') is True (core comparison decides before prerelease examination).
Existing pytest suite in tests/ passes unchanged.
out_of_scope: Do not change Version.parse validation (it must keep rejecting non-canonical prereleases like '01', '01.2', '١٢', '１２').
Do not change the optional native parser backend (_native_parse_parts).
Do not modify any test files in tests/.
Do not modify documentation files in docs/ or changelog.d/.
Do not modify packaging files (pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, MANIFEST.in, Makefile, tox.ini, uv.lock).
Do not change Version constructor behavior (accepts leading zeros and non-ASCII digits, stores prerelease as given).
Do not change build metadata handling (ignored in comparisons).
Do not change release ordering (prerelease < release for same core version).
Do not change any other Version methods (bump_*, replace, finalize_version, match, next_version, is_compatible, __hash__, __str__, __repr__, __getitem__).
external_references_needed: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 specification (https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html) clauses 9-11 for prerelease and build metadata ordering.
Python int() digit limit behavior (CPython 3.11+ raises ValueError for strings longer than 4300 digits; sys.set_int_max_str_digits).
